projects.title: WKEYONE
projects.subtitle: AI-powered WhatsApp business automation platform
projects.summary: A sales management and business intelligence platform built on WhatsApp, for companies handling thousands of conversations a month.
overview: A sales management and business intelligence platform built on WhatsApp, designed for companies handling thousands of conversations a month, where losing a single order is not an option.
Not a reply bot. A full operating layer on top of the channel where customers in the region actually buy.

capabilities.label: Intelligent sales engine
capabilities.body: Understands text, voice and images, responds with your real business data within seconds, and detects purchase intent inside the conversation, turning it into a registered order.

capabilities.label: Lifecycle automation
capabilities.body: From first inquiry, to order confirmation, to recovering hesitant customers with personalised follow-ups at the right moment.

capabilities.label: Built-in business intelligence
capabilities.body: Daily AI reports and real-time analytics on revenue, orders and customer behaviour, delivered on WhatsApp.

capabilities.label: Enterprise-ready architecture
capabilities.body: Multiple numbers, role-based teams, targeted campaigns, Meta Cloud API integration, and an open API for existing systems.

outcome: Live in 15 minutes: connect a number, add business data, and the platform runs. No developers, no code.
The standard held throughout: zero missed messages, zero lost orders.

projects.title: Headshot
projects.subtitle: Evidence-based OSINT and lead intelligence platform
projects.role: Product architecture, OSINT engine, AI layer, reliability
projects.summary: A public-web investigation platform that discovers, enriches, verifies and prioritizes leads through evidence graphs, entity resolution and autonomous pivots.
overview: Headshot turns fragmented public data into a structured investigation workflow for sales, research and market-intelligence teams. A user can start from a business category, location, company, domain, email, phone or username, then let the system discover candidates, extract evidence, resolve entities and score the result.

The product is positioned as lead intelligence rather than scraped data: every useful claim is tied to source, timestamp, evidence family and confidence, so the output can be reviewed instead of blindly trusted.

The current V2 baseline is covered by 503 passing tests across discovery, entity resolution, evidence handling, pivot correctness, planner behavior, Arabic/English handling, AI-off execution and failure recovery.

capabilities.label: Multi-channel discovery
capabilities.body: Searches across web, geographic and entity channels using business categories, domains, names, emails, phones, usernames, Arabic, English and Franco-Arabic queries.

capabilities.label: Deep crawling and extraction
capabilities.body: Extracts company names, people, titles, emails, phones, addresses, social profiles, metadata, external links and obfuscated contact details from public websites.

capabilities.label: Domain and infrastructure intelligence
capabilities.body: Builds intelligence profiles from DNS, RDAP, SSL certificates, subdomains, SPF, DMARC, security.txt, Wayback, URLScan, IP and registry data.

capabilities.label: Entity resolution and evidence graph
capabilities.body: Connects organizations, domains, people, emails, phones, social profiles and infrastructure while preserving the evidence behind each relationship.

capabilities.label: Autonomous pivot planner
capabilities.body: Generates next-best investigation paths such as certificate to organization to related domains, or filing to subsidiary to domain and infrastructure.

capabilities.label: Lead scoring and dossiers
capabilities.body: Turns raw findings into lead profiles with identity, contactability, business signals, confidence, connections and recommended next action.

capabilities.label: Contradiction handling
capabilities.body: Keeps conflicting evidence visible instead of overwriting it, separating verified evidence from inference to reduce false positives.

capabilities.label: AI-assisted, AI-off capable
capabilities.body: Uses LLMs for research, classification, analysis and strategy when useful, while preserving deterministic operation without provider dependency.

projects.architecture: Discover -> Crawl -> Extract -> Resolve -> Evidence Graph -> Pivot Planner -> Verify -> Score -> Dossier / Export
challenge: Public-web lead research usually breaks across search engines, maps, websites, DNS tools, certificate search, company registries, social profiles and spreadsheets.
The hard part is not only collecting fields; it is deciding which records describe the same entity, which relationships are supported by independent evidence, and which leads deserve action now.
The system also had to work across English, Arabic and Franco-Arabic inputs while avoiding false merges between similar company or person names.
approach: Built a discovery-to-action pipeline: Discover -> Enrich -> Resolve -> Connect -> Verify -> Score -> Act.
Modeled companies, people, domains, emails, phones, websites, IPs, registries and social profiles as graph entities with provenance and confidence.
Added autonomous pivoting so the engine can move from a company to a domain, certificate, related domain, IP, registry, organization, filing or analytics signal, then decide the next useful probe.
Kept AI optional. Discovery, extraction, resolution, evidence, pivoting and scoring continue to run when AI providers are disabled or unavailable.
outcome: Reframed the product from a scraper into an evidence-based intelligence pipeline for public-web lead research.
Reached a frozen V2 baseline with 503/503 tests passing before real-world discovery-quality measurement.
Produced structured outputs as JSON, CSV, HTML and Markdown dossiers for sales or research workflows.

projects.title: LAI
projects.subtitle: Multi-provider AI chat application for iOS
projects.summary: Several AI providers behind one interface, with an abstraction layer that lets the provider change without touching application logic.
overview: A platform that brings several AI providers together behind one interface. Rather than binding the app directly to each provider, an abstraction layer lets the AI provider change without changing application logic.
LAI v1 is a comprehensive iOS application that integrates multiple AI models into a unified conversational interface.

capabilities.label: Multi-AI integration
capabilities.body: Access to Gemini, Mistral and OpenRouter APIs through one surface.

capabilities.label: Conversation management
capabilities.body: Persistent chat history with context preservation and contextual smart replies.

capabilities.label: Image analysis
capabilities.body: AI-powered interpretation of visual content.

capabilities.label: Resilience
capabilities.body: Crash recovery, data validation, retry mechanisms, string safety and input validation.

approach: Modular AI model factory design, so a new provider is an addition rather than a rewrite.
Modern iOS architecture patterns with SwiftUI and adaptive theming.
Efficient conversation storage and maintenance algorithms.
outcome: Multi-API integration strategies for diverse AI capabilities, resilient mobile architecture, and conversation context and memory management at scale.

projects.title: PULSE
projects.subtitle: Revenue intelligence and autonomous sales operations platform
projects.role: Product architecture, backend, AI provider gateway, sales workflow design
projects.summary: A revenue-intelligence platform that turns raw customer data, company research, sales signals, conversations, follow-ups and deals into one actionable workspace.
overview: PULSE is a SaaS platform for managing the sales cycle from messy customer data to intelligence, opportunity, conversation, follow-up and deal movement.
The product brings together CRM-style records, account research, business signals, smart inbox workflows, deal management, company knowledge and multi-provider AI orchestration inside one workspace.
Instead of asking only who to contact, PULSE is designed to answer why now: what changed, what evidence supports the opportunity, and what the next sales action should be.
challenge: Sales teams often keep customer data, research, emails, CRM updates, follow-ups and deal notes across disconnected tools and spreadsheets.
AI outputs are only useful when grounded in the company context, product positioning, ICP, past conversations and account evidence.
The platform needed workspace isolation, secure provider credentials, OAuth flows and auditable activity while still feeling operationally simple for a sales team.
approach: Designed the core workflow around Raw Data -> Account Intelligence -> Research -> Signals -> Why Now -> Opportunity -> Strategy -> Conversation -> Follow-up -> Deal.
Built a workspace architecture where each team owns its customer data, knowledge base, providers, connections, opportunities, conversations, deals and activity logs.
Added a provider gateway that maps business tasks to AI providers and models, supports fallback, and records provider, model, usage, latency and failure details.
Connected conversations to accounts, contacts, opportunities and deals so email becomes part of the sales operation rather than a separate inbox.

capabilities.label: Unified customer data
capabilities.body: Imports, validates, maps, cleans and deduplicates companies, contacts, emails, websites, titles and customer records into a structured account database.

capabilities.label: Account and opportunity intelligence
capabilities.body: Builds account profiles with contacts, interactions, research, signals, opportunities, conversations, deals and recommended next actions.

capabilities.label: Why-now signal engine
capabilities.body: Transforms events such as hiring, expansion, launches, leadership changes or market movement into evidence-backed reasons to engage.

capabilities.label: Smart inbox and conversation intelligence
capabilities.body: Associates Gmail or Outlook conversations with companies, contacts, opportunities and deals, then supports summaries, suggested replies and approval flows.

capabilities.label: Follow-up and deal operations
capabilities.body: Schedules, reschedules, completes and cancels follow-ups while tying each deal back to the account intelligence that created it.

capabilities.label: Company knowledge center
capabilities.body: Stores company context, products, services, ICP, target markets, positioning, FAQs, website context and reference documents for grounded AI operations.

capabilities.label: Multi-provider AI routing
capabilities.body: Routes research, reply generation, critique, strategy and extraction tasks across OpenRouter, OpenAI, Gemini and Anthropic with provider fallback.

capabilities.label: Security and workspace isolation
capabilities.body: Protects customer data through sessions, role-based access, OAuth security, encrypted provider credentials, secret masking and auditable activity.

projects.architecture: Authentication -> Workspace Management -> Data Layer -> Customer Knowledge -> Research & Intelligence -> Signals -> Opportunities -> Conversations -> Follow-ups -> Deals -> Activity, with a unified AI Provider Gateway across OpenRouter, OpenAI, Gemini and Anthropic.
outcome: Defined a full revenue-intelligence operating system that combines CRM, smart inbox, AI research, opportunity generation, follow-up management and deal context.
Created a customer-onboarding path from workspace setup to data import, knowledge capture, connections, providers and operational readiness.
Separated business tasks from AI providers so the platform can change models without changing the sales workflow.

projects.title: KEYONE Data
projects.subtitle: Large-scale analytics engine
projects.summary: An analytics engine over hundreds of millions of records, built on DuckDB and Parquet with a FastAPI query layer.
overview: A project built specifically for large-scale analytics, handling hundreds of millions of records.
approach: DuckDB and Apache Parquet as the storage and execution layer.
A FastAPI query layer built on top of it.
The engineering focus was performance, pagination and query optimisation.

projects.title: YkChat
projects.subtitle: Real-time iOS messaging application
projects.summary: A messaging application built on MVVM, covering real-time text, media, audio and location messaging.
overview: A messaging application that leans on modern software architecture and mature libraries to deliver a seamless experience. It employs MVVM throughout, keeping separation of concerns clear and the codebase maintainable.

capabilities.label: Real-time messaging
capabilities.body: Text, images, video and audio sent and received instantly, with sent, delivered and read status tracking.

capabilities.label: Media and voice
capabilities.body: Photo, video and audio sharing, with integrated recording for voice messages.

capabilities.label: Location sharing
capabilities.body: Users can share their current location with contacts, displayed on a map.

capabilities.label: Accounts
capabilities.body: Secure registration and login, customisable profiles with display names and avatars, and push notifications for incoming messages.

approach: Custom classes for each feature area, including incoming and outgoing message handling and audio recording, following MVVM and Clean Architecture patterns.
Realm for local storage, so messages save and retrieve efficiently offline.
